Chapter 1069: 14 Who Is The Venerable One? (Seeking Monthly Votes)_3

Chapter 1069: Chapter 14 Who is the Venerable One? (Seeking Monthly Votes)_3

The young man in front of him, who had ties to the Stone People Clan, is highly likely to also be a Venerable.

If he’s not a Venerable, then even if the reward were ten or a hundred times more precious than the Chaos Tree, he’d still need the capability to obtain it.

“But I cannot guarantee that I will save all the Stone People Clan. However, you and I can definitely be saved.”

Lin Yuan spoke.

“Cannot guarantee saving all the Stone People Clan…”

For some reason, when Cang Yulong heard this, he let out a sigh of relief instead.

If Lin Yuan guaranteed everything, Cang Yulong would have been uneasy.

Currently, all the Stone People Clan were inside Nine Profound Venerable’s Cosmic Domain, with only Cang Yulong suffering outside, enduring the torment of the Sinful Pool.

Lin Yuan guaranteeing the rescue of all the Stone People Clan was fundamentally unrealistic.

“As long as senior is willing to act, I will entrust everything to you.”

Cang Yulong said solemnly.

At this moment, he had no other options.

“Alright.”

“Wait here for a moment.”

After Lin Yuan finished speaking, his figure disappeared.

“Senior has left.”

Cang Yulong glanced around but could no longer see Lin Yuan’s figure.

After a long while.

A childish voice suddenly resonated in his mind.

“You brat, you scared me to death earlier! I almost thought I was going to be discovered.” The childish voice revealed a tone of fear and trepidation.

“Can we really trust that senior?” Cang Yulong asked in his heart.

Earlier, it was precisely this childish voice that reminded him that Lin Yuan and Nine Profound Venerable were not on the same side, leading Cang Yulong to ultimately disclose everything.

“Don’t worry. That person has no causal connection with Nine Profound. They likely don’t even know each other. His infiltration here is most likely because he truly has ties with your Stone People Clan.”

The childish voice sounded surprised, “I didn’t expect your Stone People Clan, such a weak and insignificant race, could actually form a connection with a Venerable.”

“Is that senior truly a Venerable?”

Cang Yulong’s heart trembled.

“I don’t know if he’s a Venerable, but his comprehension of space-time should have reached the Eighth Realm.” The childish voice replied.

“The Eightfold Realm of Space-Time.”

Cang Yulong swallowed nervously. To his knowledge, not all Chaos Venerables have reached such a level of space-time mastery.

…

Outside the Nine Profound Secret Realm.

Lin Yuan’s figure reappeared.

“That Stone People Clan…”

Lin Yuan recalled Cang Yulong’s appearance, and in his fleeting encounter with him, he vaguely sensed another consciousness wave hidden in Cang Yulong’s body.

This feeling was faint and elusive, one that even a peak Chaos Venerable might not be able to detect.

“It seems that kid has secrets, but the Chaos Tree should be real.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

“For the sake of a Chaos Tree, it’s worth mobilizing two Primordial Spirits.”

Lin Yuan murmured.

The Chaos Tree is invaluable, one of the rare treasures that can directly enhance the foundational strength of a Venerable.

It would be of significant assistance to Lin Yuan.

It could even aid in advancing the third layer of the “Infinite Void” to a certain extent.

“Primordial Spirit.”

Lin Yuan raised his head and looked in a specific direction.

…

Outside the Chaos Continent of Ancient Ming, amidst the boundless Chaos Void.

Lin Yuan’s Taiyang Divine Spirit was seated cross-legged.

“Using the avatar as a coordinate, ultra-long-distance teleportation can be performed directly.”

Both of Lin Yuan’s Primordial Spirits mused internally.

This is one of the abilities of the Eighth Realm of Space-Time. As long as there is a “coordinate” to sustain the teleportation, ultra-long-distance traversal could be executed.

To confront Nine Profound Venerable at the Chaos Realm level, relying solely on an avatar wouldn’t suffice. To ensure success, mobilizing two Primordial Spirits was a safer move.

Once Lin Yuan’s two Primordial Spirits merge into the Taiji Primordial Spirit, its combat and killing capabilities would be only a notch below his true self.

It would also possess the strength nearing the threshold of the Chaos Realm.

“Begin.”

Dense space-time ripples emanated from around the Taiyang and Taiyin Primordial Spirits. In an instant, they disappeared.

…

Inside the Nine Profound Secret Realm.

Within the Sinful Pool.

Cang Yulong remained immersed in it.

“Could senior have had a change of heart?” Cang Yulong endured mental torment.

If despair were constant, Cang Yulong might have been able to hold up. But having hope, only to fall back into despair, created an indescribable pain in his heart.

“You brat, just wait patiently! Why…” The childish voice was about to scold Cang Yulong but abruptly stopped mid-sentence.

The next moment.

A figure appeared again by the Sinful Pool.

It was Lin Yuan.

“Senior.”

Cang Yulong’s spirit lifted.

“These chains…” Lin Yuan scrutinized the chains binding Cang Yulong’s limbs and body.

These chains didn’t just imprison Cang Yulong’s physical body but also shackled his soul and spirit.

To rescue Cang Yulong, these chains must be severed.

“I will sever these chains as quickly as possible. It may be very painful.” Lin Yuan warned.

“Senior, go ahead and do whatever you need. Over all these years, I have excelled at nothing, but pain? That’s a minor issue.” Cang Yulong replied immediately.

“Alright.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

There was an option to gradually wear down the chains. However, that would take too much time. The moment he started to wear the chains down, Nine Profound Venerable would become aware.

…

At the highest point of the Nine Profound Secret Realm.

Within a grand and majestic hall.

Nine Profound Venerable sat on his throne.

“That mysterious space already contains some kind of inheritance. Being able to suppress it with the Chaos Tree indicates that it’s highly likely an inheritance of the Great Saint level.”

Nine Profound Venerable began envisioning possibilities. To receive a Great Saint-level inheritance right after advancing to the Chaos Realm?

Nine Profound Venerable considered himself extraordinarily fortunate.

The only pity was that the Stone People Clan brat had beaten him to it.

But now the brat and the entire Stone People Clan were in his grasp.

Nine Profound Venerable believed it was only a matter of time before he acquired everything in that inheritance space.

Suddenly.

Nine Profound Venerable’s expression changed as he sensed that the aura around the Sinful Pool had completely disappeared, along with his connection to Cang Yulong.

“Not good!”

Nine Profound Venerable roared in fury.

At that instant, the hall was suddenly enveloped by an oppressive, scorching atmosphere filled with ancient majesty, capable of burning the heavens and boiling the earth.

A young man appeared between heaven and earth, hands clasped behind his back, blocking Nine Profound Venerable’s path.

“You?”

Nine Profound Venerable fixed his gaze on the young man before him, his expression shifting subtly.
